simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַלְמֻגִּים (H484) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַלְמֻגִּים (ʼalmuggîym) means almug (i.e. probably sandle-wood) sticks First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 10 11.

definitions.full: H484. almuggim אַלְמֻגִּים noun [masculine] plural id. אַלְמֻגִּים עֲצֵי 1Kin 10:11-12 , (from Ophir); ׳ע ׳הָא 10:12 .
definitions.rootNote: probably of foreign derivation (used thus only in the plural);
